_README: REGISTRY DUY NHAT anh xa TEN-Y-NGHIA -> Discord channel/topic ID that cua fleet Mike.
DAY LA NOI DUY NHAT trong repo duoc phep chua mot Discord snowflake ID viet tran.
bin/discord_id_gate.sh (pre-commit) CHAN commit neu ID 18-19 chu so xuat hien trong
bin/*.sh, bin/*.py hay hooks/*.sh o ngoai file nay.
bash : bin/notify_thread.sh "<msg>" trading_daily      # truyen TEN, khong truyen ID
id=$(bin/discord_channel.sh trading_daily)       # khi that su can ID tran
py   : from discord_channels import resolve; resolve('trading_daily')
THEM CHANNEL MOI: them 1 entry vao 'channels' duoi day (ten slug snake_case) roi dung
ten do o moi noi. KHONG bao gio copy ID vao file khac.
Lich su: 4 lan ro ri cheo topic (2026-07-01 DollarBill, 2026-07-06 Taylor multi-topic,
2026-07-22 override dead-code, 2026-07-22b job-record/agent-env lech nhau) deu vi ID
tran khong kiem chung duoc + logic phan giai bi nhan ban o nhieu file. Xem

mikefleet.title: #mikefleet
